title: Nosferatu
description: The unauthorized Dracula adaptation that courts tried to destroy. Max Schreck's Count Orlok is pure nightmare fuel.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: Lon Chaney's unmasked Phantom shocked 1925 audiences in this silent Gothic masterpiece.

title: White Zombie
description: Bela Lugosi commands an army of the undead on a Haitian sugar plantation in the first zombie feature ever made.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: A millionaire offers $10,000 to anyone who survives one night in a haunted mansion. Vincent Price at his most devilish.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A hapless florist cultivates a man-eating plant with a taste for blood. The original horror-comedy classic.

title: Carnival of Souls
description: A church organist survives a car crash, then is drawn to an abandoned pavilion by pale, silent strangers. A haunting indie landmark.

title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
description: A surgeon keeps his fiancee's severed head alive while hunting for a replacement body. Gruesome, sleazy, unforgettable.

title: Dementia 13
description: Coppola's early slasher: a scheming widow, an Irish castle, and an axe murderer picking off the heirs one by one.

title: The Terror
description: Jack Nicholson pursues a mysterious woman along a foggy coastline to a baron's crumbling castle.

title: The Last Man on Earth
description: Vincent Price plays the last uninfected man in a world of the walking dead, in the first screen version of 'I Am Legend.'

title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
description: A family stumbles into a desert cult ruled by the sinister Master. Famously one of the worst - and most beloved - films ever made.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: Strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse as the dead walk. The film that invented the modern zombie.

title: The 39 Steps
description: Hitchcock's wrong-man classic: a fugitive handcuffed to a stranger races to clear his name.

title: Detour
description: A hitchhiker's bad luck spirals into doom in the bleakest film noir ever made, shot for almost nothing.

title: Scarlet Street
description: A mild-mannered painter falls for a femme fatale who bleeds him dry. Lang at his cruelest.

title: The Stranger
description: Welles hunts a Nazi war criminal hiding as a small-town professor, with Edward G. Robinson closing in.

title: The Red House
description: A farmhand's curiosity about the forbidden woods beyond the farm awakens a long-buried secret.

title: D.O.A.
description: A man walks into a police station to report his own murder - then has 48 hours to find his killer.

title: The Hitch-Hiker
description: Two friends pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a murderer. The only classic noir directed by a woman.

title: Suddenly
description: Frank Sinatra plays a cold-blooded assassin waiting in a small town for the president's train.

title: Metropolis
description: A visionary silent epic of a divided future city - the most influential science-fiction film ever made.

title: Rocketship X-M
description: A rushed moon mission goes wrong and lands on Mars instead. The film that launched 1950s sci-fi cinema.

title: The Man from Planet X
description: A visitor from a dying world lands in Scotland with unclear intentions.

title: It! The Terror from Beyond Space
description: A Mars rescue crew brings something deadly back to Earth. The movie that inspired 'Alien.'

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
description: Aliens resurrect the dead to stop humanity's weapons research. The most entertaining bad movie ever made.

title: Teenagers from Outer Space
description: A young alien rebels against his invasion fleet to save Earth - and a small-town girl.

title: The Killer Shrews
description: Giant mutant shrews trap survivors on an isolated island. Low-budget creature-feature fun.

title: The Giant Gila Monster
description: A small Texas town faces a gigantic lizard with a taste for hot rods and teenagers.

title: One Week
description: Newlyweds build a DIY house from mislabeled parts in Keaton's breakout short.

title: The Kid
description: The Tramp raises an abandoned child in Chaplin's first masterpiece.

title: Sherlock Jr.
description: A projectionist dreams himself into the movie screen to become a great detective.

title: The General
description: Keaton's Civil War train chase - the greatest silent comedy ever made.

title: His Girl Friday
description: The fastest-talking comedy ever: a scheming editor tries to win back his star-reporter ex-wife.

title: The Sin of Harold Diddlebock
description: Harold Lloyd's comeback: a mild clerk goes gloriously wild after a single drink.

title: Beat the Devil
description: Bogart leads a gang of con artists chasing uranium in this sly, improvised farce.

title: Charade
description: Audrey Hepburn and Cary Grant dodge killers across Paris in the most charming thriller-comedy ever made.

title: The Phantom Empire
description: Singing cowboy Gene Autry discovers an underground sci-fi kingdom beneath his ranch. A gloriously weird serial.

title: The Painted Stallion
description: A wagon train, a stolen payroll, and a painted horse in this classic Republic serial.

title: Billy the Kid Returns
description: Roy Rogers stars as the legendary outlaw in this action-packed B-western.

title: Jesse James at Bay
description: Roy Rogers doubles as Jesse James and the lookalike hired to impersonate him.

title: Angel and the Badman
description: John Wayne's wounded gunfighter is nursed back to health by a Quaker family - and rethinks his life.

title: McLintock!
description: John Wayne brawls and blusters through cattle country in this rowdy comedy-western.

title: Intolerance
description: Four stories across the centuries, one theme: humanity's cruelty. Cinema's first mega-spectacle.

title: Broken Blossoms
description: A gentle immigrant shelters an abused girl in Griffith's tender, tragic melodrama.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: A hypnotist's sleepwalker may be a murderer in the landmark of German Expressionism.

title: The Mark of Zorro
description: Douglas Fairbanks swashbuckles through old California in the original masked-hero adventure.

title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
description: Lon Chaney's Quasimodo swings through this lavish silent epic.

title: Battleship Potemkin
description: Sailors mutiny against tyranny; the Odessa Steps sequence changed cinema forever.

title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
description: Falconetti's face in close-up carries one of the most devastating performances ever filmed.

title: Reefer Madness
description: The infamous anti-marijuana scare film - now a beloved camp classic.
